notes.title: Unplagued version 1.0.1 is out!
notes.notes:
[b]Unplagued version 1.0.1 is out![/b]

Patch Notes:
- Joining empty lobbies no longer prevents you from joining other lobbies.

- Overhauled private lobby system. You can now invite your Steam friends. Invitations must be accepted from the main menu.

- Fixed voice chat issues.

Thanks for your patience :)
